cancellation: Free cancellation up to 48 hours before check-in. Cancellations within 48 hours are non-refundable.
idRules: Government approved photo ID is mandatory for all adult guests (Aadhaar, Passport, Driving License, Voter ID).
PAN cards are not accepted as valid identity proof.
coupleRules: Couples welcome with valid individual photo identification.
childRules: Children up to 5 years stay free using existing bedding.
